SELECT n.novel_id, n.author_id, n.title, u.nickname AS author_name, n.cover_url, n.description, n.status, n.audit_status, n.total_words, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM novel n JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = n.author_id
ORDER BY n.updated_at DESC, n.novel_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM novel n JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = n.author_id

SELECT c.chapter_id, c.novel_id, n.title AS novel_title, u.nickname AS author_name, c.chapter_no, c.title, c.word_count, c.is_vip, c.status, c.audit_status, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM chapter c JOIN novel n ON n.novel_id = c.novel_id JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = n.author_id
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.chapter_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT c.chapter_id, c.novel_id, n.title AS novel_title, u.nickname AS author_name, c.chapter_no, c.title, c.content, c.word_count, c.is_vip, c.status, c.audit_status, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM chapter c JOIN novel n ON n.novel_id = c.novel_id JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = n.author_id WHERE c.chapter_id = #{chapterId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM novel WHERE novel_id = #{novelId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter WHERE chapter_id = #{chapterId}
